content: How do you route this from the top? From the inside our the outside?

Not sure why you wouldn't route this through the other opening.  And from the perspective of these pictures you're plugging in the filament sensor ( the only one not plugged in ) on the right.  It is the "left" when looking at it from the front of the printer.  You're plugging it into the first slot at the top "left" of the xBuddy board in these pictures.
The cable is on the left, facing the printer. The left opening of the xBuddy box is on the left side of the printer. Confusing.
